scope: Nineteen printed Alpha/Beta dual frames; no geometry/pigment fit is promoted
conclusion: All nineteen original printed duals were visually reviewed at full card, top-left and bottom-left zoom. Native frames are unchanged from the prior corrected-outline candidates. Palette selection is retained; vertical outline geometry and stock texture remain open. These are reviewed residuals, not bad scans or per-card offsets. Separate art/paper strips show near-aligned top/side edges but lower edges about 2–4 canonical pixels low. A global frame translation would therefore disturb already aligned edges; retain separate landmark measurements.
